text: An n×n matrix over F whose characteristic polynomial has n distinct roots in F is necessarily:
choices: similar to a single Jordan block
explanation: Eigenvectors for distinct eigenvalues are linearly independent, so n distinct eigenvalues yield an eigenbasis. Invertibility can still fail — 0 may be one of the distinct eigenvalues — and a single n×n Jordan block is the extreme opposite: one eigenvalue, one eigenvector line.
